frame_rate_feel: Source is 30fps per metadata.json, but nothing in the sampled frames suggests full-rate character animation — poses are held identical across many consecutive ~1-second-apart samples and change only once via a hard snap (the eye pose), suggesting the character performance itself is animated on a low frame rate (holds of a second or more, i.e. something like 'on 2s' or sparser) even if the camera push and any un-sampled subtle mouth motion run smoother. overall_animation_style_notes: Visual formula for this beat: a static-feeling stop-motion-styled two-shot of a couple embracing in a kitchen, deadpan/unimpressed puppet expressions held for most of the line, then one exaggerated wide-eyed 'shocked/judgmental' snap-take on the punchline word, all under a slow push-in and yellow serif title-card bookending (title card at open, black 'LOW BATTERY PEOPLE / CREATED BY NIN. / NEW EPISODE DAILY' card at close).
